title: Colorado PUC Decision C26-0030: Commission Decision Granting Motion for Partial and Temporary Waiver of Electric Tariff Sheet Nos. 143c-F and Waiver of Response Time
summary: Commission Decision Granting Motion for Partial and Temporary Waiver of Electric Tariff Sheet Nos. 143c-F and Waiver of Response Time
text:
Decision No. C26-0030 
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF COLORADO 
PROCEEDING NO. 25AL-0501E 
IN THE MATTER OF ADVICE LETTER NO. 2007 - ELECTRIC FILED BY PUBLIC SERVICE 
COMPANY OF COLORADO TO REVISE ITS COLORADO P.U.C. NO. 8 - ELECTRIC 
TARIFF TO REVISE THE ELECTRIC COMMODITY ADJUSTMENT FACTORS 
APPLICABLE TO ALL ELECTRIC BASE RATES SCHEDULES, TO BECOME EFFECTIVE 
JANUARY 1, 2026. 
COMMISSION DECISION GRANTING 
MOTION FOR PARTIAL AND TEMPORARY WAIVER OF 
ELECTRIC TARIFF SHEET NOS. 143C-F AND 
WAIVER OF RESPONSE TIME 
Issued Date: 
January 14, 2025 
Adopted Date: December 17, 2025 

I. 
BY THE COMMISSION 
A. 
Statement, Findings, and Conclusions 
1. 
On November 26, 2025, Public Service Company of Colorado (“Public Service” or 
the “Company”) filed Advice Letter No. 2007 – Electric (“Advice Letter”). The principal purpose 
of Public Service's filing is to revise the Company's Electric Commodity Adjustment Factors 
applicable to all electric base rate schedules in the Company’s approved Colorado PUC 
No. 8 – Electric Tariff, with a proposed effective date of January 1, 2026. 
2. 
Alongside its Advice Letter, the Company filed a Motion for Partial and Temporary 
Waiver requesting a waiver of the Sheet Nos. 143C-F of its Electric Triff to allow it to include in 
the Electric Commodity Adjustment Revenue Requirement (“ECARR”) for the first quarter of 
2026 the retail allocation of a liquidated damages payment true-up associated with the Company’s 
Colorado PUC E-Filings System

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado 
Decision No. C26-0030 
PROCEEDING NO. 25AL-0501E 
2 
Cabin Creek Facility. The Company states it is requesting the waiver at this time so that the 
payment can be credited to the ECARR and thus reduce the Electric Commodity Adjustment 
(“ECA”) for its customers. 
3. 
Public Service states this request is consistent with the Settlement Agreement 
approved by Decision No. R25-0488 in Proceeding No. 24A-0299E. The Company requests that 
the Commission waive response time as the Motion is unopposed, and no one will be harmed by 
a reduction of the customers’ ECA rate. 
4. 
In addition to updating the quarterly ECA Factors, the Company requests some 
ECA Tariff language updates on Sheet Nos. 143C-H. These updates include minor administrative 
language changes, changes related to the Time-of-Use (“TOU”) period definitions, and new 
language to allow for the recovery of certain new Company-owned renewable resource costs and 
credits for the Cabin Creek Facility that have already been approved by the Commission for 
inclusion in the ECA. The Company states these updates are necessary to align with the TOU 
period changes previously approved by the Commission in Decision No. C25-0415 in Proceeding 
No. 24AL-0377E. 
5. 
The Company filed an Amended Advice Letter on December 2, 2025, that corrected 
a typographical error in the Advice Letter. 
6. 
On December 16, 2025, the Company filed a corrected version of Confidential 
Exhibit 10a-Q1’26 Generation Detail and Assumptions, which made a correction related to the 
calculation of the Company’s ECA adjustment. 
7. 
Commission Staff reviewed the Advice Letter, the accompanying tariffs, and the 
work papers provided and concluded there are no material issues with the filings and therefore 
recommended the Commission take no further action and allow this Advice Letter to go into effect 

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado 
Decision No. C26-0030 
PROCEEDING NO. 25AL-0501E 
3 
by operation of law, and that the accompanying Motion for Partial and Temporary Waiver be 
approved. 
8. 
We find good cause exists to grant the Company's Motion for Partial and 
Temporary Waiver, pursuant to Rules 1003 and 1400 of the Commission's Rules of Practice and 
Procedure, 4 Code of Colorado Regulations 723-1. 
II. 
ORDER 
A. 
The Commission Orders That: 
1. 
The Motion for Partial and Temporary Waiver of Electric Tariff Sheet Nos. 143C-F 
and Waiver of Response Time, filed by Public Service Company of Colorado on August 29, 2025, 
is granted. 

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado 
Decision No. C26-0030 
PROCEEDING NO. 25AL-0501E 
4 
2. 
This Decision is effective upon its Issued Date. 
B. 
ADOPTED IN COMMISSIONERS’ WEEKLY MEETING 
DECEMBER 17, 2025.
